title: Air Force Lunex crewed moon-base plan

tellings.quote:
I
recently learned that the Air Force had
detailed plans for like an Air Force
manned mission to the moon.

plain: Between about 1957 and 1961, the US Air Force reportedly drew up detailed plans, under the name Lunex, for its own crewed mission to the Moon and a base there, tied to Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. An unnamed guest researcher says, without naming a source, that he "recently learned" of these plans. It would mean the military had its own Moon ambitions separate from the civilian space agency.
